_about: Pre-registered readouts of live changes (readouts.py, agent-tasks-0929-spec.md). Criteria are written BEFORE the data exists and are never edited after the window opens -- a revision is a new entry with a new id. Every expectation below is quoted from the spec named in 'spec'.

readouts.title: trend_quality: forecast 0.000 treated as no data

criteria.keep: combined (all 15m trend entries) minus the non-relaxed ones: lower 95% >= -0.10 pp AND at least one relaxed entry before a winner's +2.5% crossing
criteria.rollback: upper 95% of the same difference < -0.10 pp

readouts.title: leader exit mode, top-5 of the day at +3%

criteria.anomaly: any 1h position switched, a position switched twice, or a switched position without an exit after 7 days + 1 day
criteria.keep: no anomaly AND mean pnl of 15m trades on rocket-days >= +1.70% (the old exits' backtest level) with n >= min_trades
criteria.rollback: anomaly, OR upper 95% of the rocket-day mean < +1.70%

readouts.rollback: LEADER_EXIT_RANK_MAX / MIN_RET back to 3 / 0.05 (X-7b), or LEADER_EXIT_ENABLED = False; restart

readouts.title: leader of the day info alert, hit rate

criteria.keep: Wilson 95% upper bound of the watchlist top-3 hit rate >= 0.69 (not shown worse than the backtest)

readouts.title: poll heartbeat: split the 'rule fired, no candidate' bucket

criteria.keep: >= 90% of the bucket explained (research readout by the scheduled Claude task)
a train-chosen rule holds on the time-split test (research readout by the scheduled Claude task)

readouts.title: per-model ML floor in shadow (KEEP = switch it on, ROLLBACK = keep the fixed floor)

criteria.keep: switch ML_FLOOR_CALIBRATION_ENABLED on: winner-days reached with the calibrated floor >= with the fixed floor AND precision at the calibrated floor >= at the fixed floor
criteria.rollback: the calibrated floor reaches fewer winner-days than the fixed floor -> the fixed floor stays

readouts.rollback: nothing to undo while in shadow; after a switch: ML_FLOOR_CALIBRATION_ENABLED = False + restart

readouts.title: ML model hot reload: swaps happen and never black out the gate

criteria.anomaly: a UTC day with >= 50 candidates at the ML gate and >= 85% of them blocked by it (08-20 blackout = 88.6%; highest other day since June 79.1%), or a model file changed > 24 h ago with no reload logged

readouts.title: mode_range_quality gate OFF: entries it would have blocked vs the rest

criteria.anomaly: more than 20 added entries per day (3x the expected 6.6)
criteria.keep: combined (all entries) minus the other entries: lower 95% >= -0.10 pp
criteria.rollback: upper 95% of the same difference < -0.10 pp
